content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Regional Logistics Performance Review and Strategic Planning Session
agenda_items: Budget allocation for fleet modernization and sustainability initiatives
Discussion of technology investment priorities for route optimization
Competitive landscape assessment and market positioning strategy
key_decisions: Approved capital investment of $2.8M for upgrading warehouse management systems at three primary facilities
Delayed expansion into secondary markets until current operations achieve 95% on-time delivery target

Elena Rodriguez, Director of Strategic Planning
James Chen, Director of Fleet Management
